TEXTILE.heading: Spinning / Knitting / Weaving / Garmenting
TEXTILE.body_content: SSM Group supplies products for the textile and apparel industries. Its experienced team follows market and regulatory developments. The published profile describes 15 manufacturing units across Tamil Nadu, with integrated facilities processing yarn and fabric through to ready-made garments.

TEXTILE.heading: A diversified group
TEXTILE.body_content: The SSM Group profile describes interests in steel fabrication, wind farming and education alongside textiles. Its vision is to build strong customer bonds and long-term relationships through manufacturing and supplying quality products.

EDUCATION.heading: Schools & College
EDUCATION.body_content: SSM Group founded SSM Matriculation School in Kuttahupatty, Dindigul, and SSM Academy at Akkarai Patti on Dindigul–Palani High Road, with the aim of providing quality education for all students.

EDUCATION.heading: SSM schools
EDUCATION.body_content: The published profile names SSM Matriculation Higher Secondary School and SSM Academy, which focuses on the CBSE curriculum. Learning emphasizes extracurricular activities so students can explore education as an enjoyable experience.

EDUCATION.heading: Learning beyond academics
EDUCATION.body_content: The schools’ published approach combines academic achievement with life skills, an educational environment and amenities for overall development. Management aims to nurture individual qualities through students’ mental and physical wellbeing.

EDUCATION.heading: SSM Institute of Engineering and Technology
EDUCATION.body_content: SSM Institute of Engineering and Technology (SSMIET), established in 2011, aims to nurture students in engineering courses and provide quality technical education to deserving rural students, helping them emerge as employers rather than employees. The published profile describes equipped laboratories, smart classrooms, a student-friendly atmosphere, support for innate talents and counselling. It records academic achievement, success in competitions conducted by premier institutions, and graduates contributing to the workforce.

EDUCATION.heading: An ambition recorded in the published profile
EDUCATION.body_content: The old website records efforts to start a school following the Indian Council for Secondary Education (ICSE) curriculum. This is a published intention; completion has not been verified.

NATURAL_ENERGY.heading: Power Plants for Sustainable Green Energy
NATURAL_ENERGY.body_content: The published profile describes a captive power plant at Pethappampatti on the Dharapuram–Pollachi road, intended to ensure a steady electricity supply for uninterrupted production.

NATURAL_ENERGY.heading: Wind farming
NATURAL_ENERGY.body_content: The Natural Energy page reports that wind farming began with 100 windmills and later exceeded 400, contributing 300 MW for manufacturing facilities. It reports that 90% of power consumed by the manufacturing units came from these windmills. These figures describe the published profile and have not been verified as current operating figures.

NATURAL_ENERGY.heading: The published wind-farming history
NATURAL_ENERGY.body_content: The Natural Energy page dates the start of wind farming with 100 windmills to 2000. The old CSR page instead gives 2005. Both are retained as source statements; the start year requires confirmation.

NATURAL_ENERGY.heading: The published energy commitment
NATURAL_ENERGY.body_content: The old Natural Energy page describes the company as a producer and user of 100% green energy. This is retained as a historical statement; the same page reports 90% wind-power consumption, so no current 100% renewable-energy claim is made here.

NATURAL_ENERGY.heading: Let’s Build Something Together
NATURAL_ENERGY.body_content: Speak with our team about your requirements and explore the next step.

BRANDS.heading: Chennis
BRANDS.body_content: Chennis is a brand by Sivaraj Spinning Mill, created for fashion-conscious young professionals seeking affordable clothing. Its casual collection is presented for different occasions and events, reflecting the attitude and vibrancy of a new generation.

BRANDS.heading: The Chennis story
BRANDS.body_content: The Brands page records a launch in 2011 and positions Chennis in casual wear, with ongoing innovation and attention to international trends and styling. The date is retained from that profile; other old-site news articles give a different launch year.

BRANDS.heading: Beyond work
BRANDS.body_content: The published collection addresses beyond-work clothing through Urban, Sport, Excursion and Club categories, with an emphasis on fit, styling and colour.

BRANDS.heading: Brand presence in India
BRANDS.body_content: The published profile records an expanding Indian network and an ambition to become a national brand by 2020. This historical ambition is retained as context; its achievement has not been verified.

CREDENTIALS_REWARDS.heading: Recognition for export performance
CREDENTIALS_REWARDS.body_content: The old Awards page explains that export awards recognize the meritorious performance of top exporters and describes recognition as an encouragement to increase export capacity and competitiveness.

CREDENTIALS_REWARDS.heading: Best Exporter Award
CREDENTIALS_REWARDS.body_content: The old website states that the Government of India awarded an Exporter Trophy and Certificate for achieving the highest yarn exports in India under the EOU category. It does not provide an award year.

CREDENTIALS_REWARDS.heading: OEKO-TEX – Eco-Friendly
CREDENTIALS_REWARDS.body_content: The old Awards page records endorsement by the International OEKO-TEX Association for avoiding harmful chemical substances during yarn production. This published recognition is historical; current certificate scope and validity must be confirmed.
